method.advance: Require at least four complete new double locations across at least three held cameras, no new ordinary flags, and no false double claim on shared-source copies. Retain earlier single locations.
method.selection: Keep existing copy proposals and color measurements. Take at most two independent pairs. The four crops need at least 16 pixels of separation across the two pairs. Decline shared crops or more than two distinct pairs.
method.source: Use pinned original quality-90 and quality-95 camera JPEGs. Make two fresh copy regions on the decoded native grid, then export at the same profile. Retain the earlier ordinary, structural and single-edit controls.
